title: Private links for your apps
summary: Share a published app privately with a one-time link, plus steadier agent setup.

items.text: Share a published app with a one-time private link.
Support is reachable from every OS view.
Codex chats continue after you switch accounts and keep their models.
Model choices are kept and stuck credit holds are cleared.
Existing Claude connections are recognized again.
Questions from agents show their full description.
Scheduled inputs are labeled on every device.
